using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

const ll MOD = 998244353;

ll mod_pow(ll base, ll exp, ll mod) {
    ll result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    ll n, m;
    int L, R;
    cin >> n >> m >> L >> R;

    ll diff = R - L + 1;
    ll p1 = diff / 2;
    ll p2 = diff - p1;
    ll nm = n * m;

    ll ans;
    if (nm % 2 == 1) {
        ans = mod_pow(diff, nm, MOD);
    } else {
        ll pp1 = diff;
        ll pp2 = abs(p1 - p2);
        ll opt1 = mod_pow(pp1, nm, MOD);
        ll opt2 = mod_pow(pp2, nm, MOD);
        ll opt = (opt1 + opt2) % MOD;
        ll inv2 = mod_pow(2, MOD - 2, MOD);
        ans = (opt * inv2) % MOD;
    }

    cout << ans << endl;

    return 0;
}
